title: Raw HTML sink (innerHTML) — review required
description: Assigning to innerHTML parses a string as HTML. If the value contains attacker-influenced data this is cross-site scripting (XSS). This lexical rule cannot prove taint — treat every hit as review-required, not as proven exploitable.
remediation: Prefer textContent for text. For markup, build DOM nodes explicitly or sanitize with a maintained allowlist sanitizer before assigning to innerHTML.
limitation: Lexical, line-based, no dataflow: any innerHTML assignment matches, including static safe markup. Reads (el.innerHTML) and strict === comparisons do not match. Framework sinks (jQuery .html(), React dangerouslySetInnerHTML) are out of scope.
